prerequisites: Basic notions of Differential and Integral Calculus
Basic notions of Fundamentals of Computer Science
Basic notions of Automation and Control
Basic notions of Digital Electronic Systems

learning_outcomes.text: Program discrete control systems on digital processors in C language.
Apply the analysis and design of regulators for hybrid control systems in practical cases.
Select the most appropriate control devices for each application.
Make the connection between the digital processor and the other elements involved in control (sensors, actuators, ...).
Perform communications in various formats between control devices.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to programming digital control systems.
Introduction to computers and C language programming.
C language programming: arrays, pointers and structures
Representation of discrete signals and systems in C language
assessment_rules: The final grade in the ordinary and extraordinary calls is calculated as 0.75 * EV1 + 0.25 * EV2, provided that minimums are met. A minimum of 4.0 out of 10 is required for EV1 (theory and practice exam), and a minimum of 5.0 out of 10 is required for EV2 (individual work). If any minimum is not reached, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated score and 4.0. If the EV2 minimum is not reached, the course will be failed in the ordinary call.
